title: Pinch reversal late at -30 °C
description: TC-AP-04 at 9.0 V and -30 °C: motor stopped 13 ms after the pinch force passed 100 N. Limit is 10 ms. Passed at 23 °C.

title: Window does not move after ignition off
description: Car parked, ignition off, pressed the switch after about 50 s: nothing happens. Spec says 60 s?

title: WLC_Status period jitter
description: WLC_Status measured at 97 to 104 ms. Within 100 ms ± 10 ms. Logging for information only.

title: Express up stops halfway in cold
description: Morning test, about -20 °C. Express close stopped at around 150 mm and reversed. Nothing in the window. Second try worked.

title: Typo in DTC table comment
description: The comment above the DTC table says B1A10 instead of B1A01. Code is correct.

title: Late stop on pinch when cold
description: Anti-pinch run at -30 °C, low supply: stop came after 14 ms. Same setup at 85 °C fine.

title: Sleep current 140 µA
description: Sleep current measured 140 µA after 60 s. Limit 100 µA. CAN transceiver seems to stay in standby, not sleep.

title: False reversal on rough road
description: Driving over cobblestones while closing the window: window reversed by itself. Happened twice in 10 tries.

title: B1A02 not stored on overcurrent
description: Injected 27 A for 100 ms. Motor stopped, but no B1A02 in memory and the fault state stays 0.

title: Switch feels slow
description: Two clinic drivers said the window reacts late when they press the switch. No measurement.

title: Auto-up reverses in cold weather without obstacle
description: Cold morning again (-18 °C). Window went up, stopped and went down. No hand or object in the way.

title: Opening possible above 140 °C
description: Thermal test TC-TH-03: after the model passed 140 °C, one open request still moved the window. The next one was refused.

title: Position drift after 200 cycles
description: After 200 open-close cycles the reported position at the top seal is 3.5 mm instead of 0 mm.

title: Window keeps moving 180 ms after switch release
description: Manual close at 16 V: motor command stays on for 180 ms after release. Limit 100 ms. At 13.5 V it is 60 ms.

title: Retained power too short
description: After switching off the engine the window only works for about 45 seconds, should be 60.

title: Missing WLC_Status frame during diagnostic requests
description: While running TC-DG-03 (100 diagnostic requests), one WLC_Status frame was missing: 200 ms between two frames instead of 100 ms.

title: User manual shows wrong switch symbol
description: Draft owner's manual page 14 shows the switch symbol upside down.

title: Hall sensor loss: motor keeps running
description: Disconnected the Hall signal while closing at 9 V. Motor ran for 1.2 s until the end stop. No DTC.

title: Thermal block lets one opening through
description: Same as seen last week? Estimated temperature 143 °C and the window still opened once.

title: Express close works when not normalized
description: After disconnecting the battery, a short press up closed the window fully. Express close should not be available until normalized.

title: Unused variable in thermal model
description: Variable t_prev in thermal_model.c is never read. Compiler warning.

title: Diagnostic response 62 ms
description: 3 of 100 diagnostic requests answered after 55 to 62 ms. Limit 50 ms. Happens while the motor starts.

title: Window reversed over cobbles
description: Cobblestone road, closing: unexpected reversal, nothing trapped.

title: Reverse polarity: controller dead
description: Applied -14 V for 60 s. Afterwards the controller does not wake up. Protection diode D3 is open.

title: Undervoltage stop 21 ms
description: Supply drop to 5.5 V: motor stopped after 21 ms. Within the 50 ms limit. For information.

title: Window closes too hard on the seal
description: Clinic drivers hear a loud knock when the window reaches the top. No damage seen.

title: No DTC when Hall connector unplugged
description: Pulled the Hall sensor connector during auto-up. Window ran into the seal and kept pushing. Nothing stored in fault memory.

title: Inrush current 14 A at 16 V
description: Start current 14 A for 40 ms at 16 V. No limit in the spec, so not a failure. Proposing a requirement.

title: Fault state not set for overcurrent
description: TC-DG-02: after overcurrent the motor stops but WLC_Status fault state stays 0 and fault memory is empty.

title: Pinch reversal only 146 mm at 85 °C
description: TC-AP-05 at 85 °C: reversal 146 mm. v1.3 limit is 150 mm. Passed at 23 °C with 162 mm.
